name: meeting-assistant-monorepo
description: Commercial Desktop Meeting Assistant - Decoupled UI & Backend

scripts.start: npm run build:ui && npm run --prefix apps/desktop start
scripts.test:billing: npm run build:ui && cargo test --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml --lib billing && node --test test/plans-client.test.js test/client-release-config.test.js && electron test/payment-ui/render.cjs
scripts.test:billing:db: cargo test --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml --bin kesami-core-backend paid_subscriptions_reach_supabase -- --ignored && cargo test --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --bin kesami-cloud-relay hosted_payment_confirms -- --ignored
scripts.test:cloud: cargo test --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --bin kesami-cloud-relay && node --test test/client-release-config.test.js
scripts.test:release: npm run build:all && npm run test:backend && npm run test:node && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:extension:browser
scripts.test:auth: cargo build --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml && node --test test/auth-flow.test.js test/auth-client.test.js test/google-desktop-auth.test.js test/plans-client.test.js
scripts.test:shell: node --test test/widget-window.test.js test/menubar-tray.test.js test/dock-icon.test.js test/system-audio.test.js test/mic-usage.test.js
scripts.test:ui: node --test test/calendar-events.test.js test/call-prompt.test.js test/meeting-chat.test.js test/live-transcript.test.js test/audio-levels.test.js test/meeting-audio-source.test.js test/print-document.test.js test/speaker-suggestions.test.js
scripts.test:chat: cargo build --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml && node --test test/meeting-chat.test.js test/meeting-chat-integration.test.js
scripts.test:actions: cargo test --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml --bin kesami-core-backend action && cargo build --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml && node --test test/post-meeting-actions-integration.test.js
scripts.test:commitments: cargo test --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml --bin kesami-core-backend commitments && cargo build --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml && node --test test/meeting-commitments-integration.test.js
scripts.test:audio: cargo build --manifest-path apps/core-backend/Cargo.toml && node --test test/live-speakers.test.js test/live-echo.test.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:ui && npm run build:backend
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:all && npm run build:mic-watch && npm run --prefix apps/desktop dist:mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && npm run --prefix apps/desktop dist:win

author: Kesami Team
